description: Pre-flight security verdict for an MCP server invocation. Judges BOTH server-level reputation AND the server's dependency graph (npm/pypi) against the DugganUSA threat-intel corpus (1.13M+ IOCs, Shai-Hulud + typosquat + LOLBin families). Returns BLOCK / ADVISORY / REVIEW / ALLOW with severity, evidence, dep-graph summary, and HMAC-signed response. REVIEW means we hold NO RECORD of this server -- not that it is safe. Treat REVIEW as do-not-proceed-blindly: a brand-new attacker-published server looks exactly like this. ALLOW is only returned when we actually resolved the server and scanned its dependency graph; check known_to_us and dep_graph.scanned to confirm. Use this BEFORE invoking any other MCP server tool, especially ones installed from outside the official MCP Registry.

server.description: REQUIRED. The server to judge: its exact MCP Registry name (io.github.owner/server-name, optionally @version). A bare name (server-name) is judged as typed, never mapped to a registry server, and the matching full names come back in input.did_you_mean. Also resolved, only when the identity is provable: a registry URL (https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0/servers/<name>) and a GitHub repo ("owner/repo" or https://github.com/owner/repo) published by that owner as exactly one registry server. Package names (npm/PyPI), images and Smithery ids are recorded but judged as given (usually REVIEW): their name does not prove which code runs. Refused: commands, shell metacharacters, non-ASCII, local paths, endpoint URLs. No substring or fuzzy matching: anything we cannot resolve to exactly one server returns REVIEW, never a guess.

tool.description: Optional name of the specific tool being invoked

version.description: Optional version of the MCP server (semver). A version inside `server` (name@1.2.3) is used when this is empty.

name: check_mcp_server
